entities.summary: Great Heathen Army, a notable figure in the history of Denmark, associated with Viking Age Denmark (793–954). Preceded by Danish Viking Raids & the Danelaw. Their legacy influenced Great's North Sea Empire and Harald Bluetooth raises the Jelling Stone, Christianising Denmark.
